content: We test these methods by participating in the Shared Task on Fine-Grained Propaganda Detection for the 2nd Workshop on NLP for Internet Freedom, for which we achieve the second rank on sentence-level classification of propaganda, confirming the importance of cost-sensitivity when the training and test sets are dissimilar.
